title: PAVOQUE Corpus of Expressive Speech
task: neutral and acted expressive speech (happy/sad/angry/poker styles; non-singing)
token_or_recording_size: six public YAML annotation files plus corresponding FLAC release assets; exact utterance/segment counts pending full YAML parse
annotation_target: utterance boundaries/text/style and phone segment labels/end times
manual_scope: README explicitly states that optional phonetic segments are manually corrected; only utterances containing those corrected segment arrays are eligible for segment-level core analyses
decision_reason: Primary non-singing German expressive-speech recordings with manually corrected phonetic segmentation and public machine-readable YAML annotations.
evidence_summary: Repository documentation specifies prompt/text/style plus utterance start/end and manually corrected SAMPA-based segment labels with segment end times relative to utterance start. Speaker is professionally trained as actor/opera singer, but corpus task is expressive speech rather than singing.
